courses.summary: AIT not only specialises in 2D Animation, we're known for producing industry ready 2D Animation graduates who land jobs! Be immersed in the world of 2D Animation, developing your skills in storyboarding, colour styling, bio-mechanics, movement, rigging, light and colour theory, as well as the principles of animation. Learn the history of this captivating artform, its relation to the moving image and its expanding use in a variety of contemporary settings today. Delivered in our purpose-built 2D Animation Studio, you'll be working beside like-minded creatives on the latest animation software and hardware, just like in a professional studio. You'll also attend multiple creative studio lab subjects, to continually build your professional-grade portfolio, while receiving mentorship from the best in the 2D Animation business.
courses.careers: Graphic designer, 2D animator, 2D designer, 2D rigger, animation artist, animation effects artist, motion designer.
courses.practicalExperience: In your final year, our Professional Internship Program places you in a professional industry organisation where you will develop relevant skills oriented toward your chosen career. It will provide you with an opportunity to apply what you know, be mentored, receive feedback and seek opportunities for development in a real-world setting, as well as be exposed to emerging trends and technology impacting your industry. Prior to commencement of the internship, AIT will determine a suitable placement company based on your individual needs and interests.

courses.name: Bachelor of Information Technology
courses.campus: AIT Academy of Information Technology Sydney
courses.area: AI, big data, and cybersecurity Cloud and software design, coding, databases, machine learning.
courses.prerequisites: All domestic candidates must: Have a Unique Student Identifier (USI) or have appropriate exemption; AND Have a unique email address; AND Have access to a computer with an internet connection; AND Be 17 years or older at the time of commencement (students under 18 will require a support letter from their parent or guardian); AND Have successfully completed an Australian Senior Certificate of Education, or equivalent, i.e. International Baccalaureate and achieved a grade of not less than 60% in at least one STEM subject; OR Have successfully completed a Certificate IV, VET Diploma or Higher Education Diploma (or higher) in a related field. If further evidence of capacity is required, candidates may be called upon to demonstrate their suitability through the successful completion of an approved AIT activity, which may include: Undertake an AIT entry exam, focussing on foundational ICT knowledge; OR Display experience or interest in the field of ICT through evidence of relevant work or practice. Students may be asked to demonstrate this through a CV, short written piece, interview and/or portfolio (a portfolio of work might consist of code snippets, small programs or program designs or website designs); OR Demonstration of relevant work experience/qualification prior to entry, such as in programming, management or supervision, engineering, or roles that require the collation and analysis of information; OR An admissions interview. Refer to the AIT's general admission criteria .
courses.assumed: Enterprise computing, Mathematics Standard 2, Software Engineering.
courses.fees: Refer to AIT latest fee information .
courses.summary: The Bachelor of Information Technology will provide students with the ability to operate as effective practitioners in ICT. Throughout the course, students will develop essential skills in programming l anguages, web development, software and database design, and professional practice. Further, students will learn how to interact, communicate and establish effective collaborative relationships to increase their opportunities for strong professional connections. This course has been strategically developed in collaboration with experts from the information technology industry to scaffold student learning so that foundational technical knowledge and professional communication skills underpin each student’s journey as they advance towards an holistic understanding of ICT industry and the specific capabilities required to be successful. Skills in ICT solution design, database programming, and cloud computing will be facilitated, allowing students the ability to develop cloud environments that incorporate the latest advancements in web technology. And, students will practise critical thinking and develop skills in data analytics, using analysis tools employed by industry experts to solve complex business problems and create opportunities for businesses. As students progress through the Bachelor of Information Technology, they will be exposed to strategic ICT project management, undertaking a range of projects during which analysis, design, planning and management will be paramount as they learn how to apply advanced DevOps techniques to scalable solutions. Additionally, students will engage in exploration and critical analysis of the ICT industry, its impact on society, and reflect on their own perspectives, learning to adopt ethical practice and professional codes of conduct. The effect of this will be further enhanced through the utilisation of self-reflection, professional feedback, networking, and personal development strategies to ensure continuous professional growth.
courses.careers: Developer programmer, software developer, ICT consultant, DevOps consultant, ICT support and test engineer, ICT support technician, data and reporting analyst, information systems analyst, network engineer, web developer, ICT sales assistant, software tester.
